title: Wait for Warmth
statement: A forecast lists daily temperatures. For each day, return how many days you have to wait for a strictly warmer day, or 0 if there is none.

answerKey.pattern: Monotonic stack of waiting day indexes
keyPoints: Keep indexes whose temperatures decrease from bottom to top
When a warmer day arrives, pop each cooler day and record the distance
Push today; days left on the stack get 0
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Scan forward from each day: O(n²)

hints: Days that have not found a warmer day yet are waiting. In what order are they?
Their temperatures decrease from bottom to top of a stack.
When today is warmer than the top, the top's answer is today − top. Pop and repeat, then push today.
